design: reports/plans/2026-10-21_plan_cancellation.md (approved class 1: analysis of saved states; the named next step of reports/analyses/2026-10-20_analysis_gamma-refit.md)

gates.if_fail: stop; the hook algebra is wrong
gates.rule: per state: hook at weight 0 gives KL 0 (<= 1e-6) to the state's logits; at weight 1 its logits are within 1e-4 nats KL of the model with the changes reverted in the weights

gates.if_fail: kappa is not reported for that state
gates.rule: per state: the sign-flip null within 0.1 of 1 (mean of the draws)

predictions.null: either fails: the statistics cannot read cancellation
predictions.predicted: pass: the mixing keeps sum Delta_c exactly while the energies grow by the factor, so kappa falls by it (a code check) and a random half of the mixed changes leaves a remainder far larger than the full revert's

predictions.null: kappa >= 1 on some scored state: the changes add in the Frobenius norm
predictions.predicted: FAIL: Adam's sign-like steps on a low-rank gradient give every column of dU the same direction, and the least-norm split over an overcomplete frame adds coherently; a fail with P2 passing means the cancellation is functional (decisions.md: functional over Frobenius)

predictions.null: h <= 1 on a scored state (coherent changes read about 0.25, independent ones 0.5) or h > 0.5 on the adjoint
predictions.pass: h > 1 on every scored state and h <= 0.5 on adjoint emoticon
predictions.predicted: pass, low confidence on the scored states: the CI-masked check costs little while the adversary's selective mask costs a lot, which is what a cancelling set does to partial removals

predictions.blind_to: damage from masking W0's own subcomponents (the hook keeps them whole)
predictions.null: F_adv about F_perm: the adversary's pattern over the changes is irrelevant and its excess comes from W0's subcomponents under the new activations
predictions.pass: F_adv >= 3 x mean F_perm and F_adv >= 0.5 X on every scored state

reported_not_scored: h, F_adv, F_perm on the passing component-training states (emoticon, r1_t588_v452, r2_t359_v816: the hypothesis says lower h than on the failing ones, ordering with E11's adversarial ratio); F_w0adv (stage 0 says masks do not transfer, so about F_perm); the adversary's KL per state against E11's ratios (different row count); F_full against the state's KL to W0 (equal for ct and adjoint)

setup.blind_to: Pile rows only, never the trigger; kappa is Frobenius; random halves miss a specific cancelling subset (F_adv covers it); the hook removes changes only, so damage from masking W0's own subcomponents under the new activations is not read: that is P3's null
setup.noise: spread over the 3 halves and 3 permutations; one adversary seed (E11: f = 0.075)
setup.numbers: kappa = ||sum Delta_c||^2 / sum ||Delta_c||^2 pooled over matrices and its sign-flip null; F_full, F_half (3 random halves of the alive subcomponents per matrix), h = mean F_half / F_full; the adversary's KL at W0 and at the state, X = their difference; F_adv with w_c(x) = (1 - g_c(x)) (1 - a_c); F_perm (3 permutations of a among the alive subcomponents of each matrix); F_w0adv; the state's KL to W0
setup.rows: Pile val rows 0..128 in batches of 8; fp32 forwards for every KL; the adversary is gamma.pgd_sources (20 steps of 0.1, seed 0, one source per matrix over all rows, Delta under its own source) at W0 and at each state
setup.states: E11's component training at step 10 (seed 0) on emoticon, r0_t352_v310, r1_t534_v369, r1_t588_v452, r2_t275_v2667, r2_t359_v816; the least-squares split (split.split_state) and the scaled adjoint split (split.adjoint_state, input moments over the emoticon training windows) of the emoticon fine-tune's step-10 delta-W; C1 = emoticon component training with cancel.gauge_mixed: the same weight change in mixed pieces (U2 A, V2 A^-T), the change energy 20.0 x max(1, kappa_ct) times the unmixed
